deceitful = behaving in a dishonest way in order to trick people
conceited = too proud of your abilities or appearance
humble = not proud; not thinking you are better than others
considerate = careful not to cause inconvenience or hurt to others
charismatic = having a personality that attracts and influences others
timid = shy and easily frightened; lacking confidence
resilient = able to recover quickly from difficulties
witty = able to say clever, amusing things quickly
inquisitive = eager to find out about things; asking many questions
aloof = not friendly or willing to take part; emotionally distant
resentment = a bitter feeling that you have been treated unfairly
elation = a feeling of great happiness and excitement
humiliation = a strong feeling of shame after being made to look foolish
anguish = severe mental or emotional pain
despair = the complete loss of hope
contentment = quiet happiness with what you have
nostalgia = a bittersweet longing for a time in the past
remorse = deep regret for something wrong you have done
envy = the unhappy feeling of wanting what someone else has
contempt = the feeling that someone or something is worthless
